jobs.title: Polylance Backend Architecture
jobs.description:
PolyLance Backend Architecture

We are building **PolyLance**, a Web3-based freelancing platform focused on secure payments, trusted reputation, and verifiable work. We are looking for an experienced backend developer to build the backend foundation that connects our frontend, database, and blockchain/smart contracts.

What You’ll Work On:

* User registration, login, and profile management
* Freelancer and client profiles
* Job posting, browsing, and management
* Proposal and application system
* Hiring and project management
* Contracts and project milestones
* Escrow and payment-related backend functionality
* Wallet authentication and blockchain integration
* Freelancer ratings and reputation system
* Proof-of-work / completed project verification
* Notifications and activity tracking
* Basic admin functionality

:Blockchain Integration

The backend should communicate with our smart contracts for important activities such as escrow, payments, transactions, and reputation. You should also handle transaction status, confirmations, failures, and synchronization between the blockchain and our database.

:Database & APIs

Design a clean database structure for users, jobs, proposals, projects, contracts, milestones, payments, reviews, reputation, and transactions.

Build secure and well-organized APIs that allow the frontend to communicate with all major platform features.

Requirements:

We want the backend to be:

* Secure and reliable
* Easy to maintain
* Fast and scalable
* Properly documented
* Easy for other developers to continue working on

**Preferred stack:** Node.js/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL, Redis, Docker, and Web3 libraries. We are open to better alternatives if you can explain your approach.

 Deliverables:
Complete backend source code, database structure, APIs, blockchain integration, authentication, core marketplace functionality, escrow/payment integration, reputation system, testing, API documentation, and deployment/setup instructions.

jobs.title: Build Mainnet Smart Contracts For PolyLance
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solidity/Web3 developer to build, test, and deploy production-ready smart contracts for PolyLance on Polygon Mainnet.

PolyLance is a decentralized freelancing platform that enables secure and transparent transactions between clients and freelancers using blockchain technology. The platform will support Polygon Mainnet with USDC and USDT payments.

The developer will review the existing PolyLance smart contract code, identify bugs or security issues, and update the contracts for production use. The contracts should support secure freelance payment and escrow flows, including job creation, client deposits, payment release, cancellation, and refunds where required.

Key responsibilities:
• Develop or update PolyLance smart contracts using Solidity.
• Implement secure escrow and payment functionality.
• Support USDC and USDT on Polygon Mainnet.
• Implement proper access control and transaction validation.
• Protect against common smart contract vulnerabilities such as reentrancy and unauthorized fund access.
• Optimize contracts for reasonable gas usage.
• Create deployment and testing scripts using Hardhat or Foundry.
• Thoroughly test critical contract functions before deployment.
• Deploy and verify contracts on Polygon Mainnet and PolygonScan.
• Provide final contract addresses, ABI files, and integration details.
• Ensure compatibility with the existing PolyLance frontend and backend.

Required experience includes Solidity, EVM, ERC-20 tokens, OpenZeppelin, Polygon, smart contract testing, and Web3 integrations. Experience with payment or escrow contracts is preferred.

Deliverables should include tested production-ready contracts, deployment scripts, verified Polygon Mainnet contracts, ABI files, contract addresses, test results, and basic documentation.

As the contracts will handle real user funds, security, reliability, and proper testing are essential before the mainnet launch.
